contact.basis: Flat western motor-court paving, visible in satellite context; avoids the sloping street outside the northwest gate.

attribution: USGS 3D Elevation Program, CA_LosAngeles_B23; US government public domain
method: Unmodified USGS bare-earth Float32 GeoTIFF, locked to CA_LosAngeles_B23 (service acquisition date 2024-07-01), sampled bilinearly at pixel centers after WGS84 to UTM11N projection. No terrain flattening or geometry fitting. Two-metre local review grid.
limitations: Ground under structures is interpolated by the source product; source resolution is not a claim of survey accuracy.
Gate contact and underlying host terrain may differ between datasets.
